title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（佐野元昭研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sano Motoaki)
educationalGoal:
Graduation research is carried out as Design Project III.
1) Understand the fundamentals of biotechnology
2) Plan and implement your own experiments
3) Discuss your results and provide feedback on your next plan
4) Summarize your research achievements as a report and make an oral presentation
advice:
The theme of graduation research (Design Project III) will be determined under the supervision of the instructor.
The seminar meets once a week. In the seminar, you report the results of experiments and discuss your research plan.
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental knowledge of bioscience such as molecular cloning and biochemistry.
